# Math

Inline and display math are passed through to KaTeX in the browser.

## Inline

The mass–energy relation is $E = mc^2$. A Gaussian integral
$\int_{-\infty}^{\infty} e^{-x^2}\,dx = \sqrt{\pi}$ is often written inline.
Code spans keep the source: `$E = mc^2$` and `` $\alpha$ ``.
